judge.rationale: The candidate implementation was stopped mid-progress (leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree with unchecked items) and fails several core functional and lint requirements. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it compiles the schema only once at `register` time even for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource`s instead of resolving per call with a `WeakMap` cache, uses default import `import Ajv from 'ajv'` and `(err as any)` casts that violate strict TypeScript/ESLint rules, and omits the required one-line doc comment on `execute`. Most required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing (with some placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead), leaving `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` with unlinked statements. Finally, the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts` were never performed, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete.
